source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: A Fire in the Old Kitchen
tts_text: The cook would activate the old stove, and then react to whatever it gave him. His methods were exact, and the results were actual, though the whole place felt almost virtual in the dark. A fragment of glass lay on the floor, fragile as a thin sheet. Only a small fraction of the flour could be saved, and just a portion of it was still dry. The proportion of what was lost to what remained was hard to accept. The framework of the shelf was burned, and he could only frown at it. Then a flame caught, and the fire began to flare and flash across the wall. The heat reached his flesh, and he had to refresh himself with cold water. Yet life would flourish again. There was still flour and powder on the top shelf. He was curious about what had happened, and he needed an accurate answer. The room was no longer secure, and the cause was obscure. He called for help to rescue what he could, but a man was already injured by the smoke. It was a real danger now, and everything was at stake. For three consecutive days the kitchen stayed shut, and the current situation was still unclear.
